objective: Make existing persisted Reel batches discoverable after reload, with bounded original-membership execution detail and existing admission recovery only.
acceptance_criteria: Persisted batch list with bounded pagination, no full catalogue scan, reloadable operation URL and direct ID lookup.

Separate admission from Reel completion; projected execution reads scoped to original selected IDs, three deterministic stages, counts explicitly scoped to page. Preserve missing/uncertain and saved quality failures without retries or new queue controls.
Only existing resume_operation action for applicable pending admission. Honest guidance for saved quality recovery and physically paused stages.
Expired authenticated session clearly offers login. All tests and builds only GitHub Actions; independent review before root merge/deploy.

context.reason: Existing authenticated read router and command contract

validation_commands: GitHub Actions only: existing google-v0 unit suites, frontend build/browser QA and task packet checks.

review.reason: Independent review of bounded persisted batch reads, original selection membership, admission-only action and session expiry UI.
